rejected.why: Viewed 2026-07-30. Wrong subject: the frame is a black-and-white close-up of Portuguese calçada paving mosaic filling the whole picture. No theatre, no building, nothing but pavement. Replaced by belem-theatro-da-paz-3.webp.

Viewed 2026-07-30. Wrong subject and defaced: it is a brown tourist direction sign reading 'Basílica de N. Sra. de Nazaré', plastered with a dozen stickers and tags including a soft-drink advertisement. The basilica itself is not in the picture. Replaced by belem-basilica-nazare-full.webp.

Viewed 2026-07-30. Badly illustrates its caption. It is a general waterfront view from the fort — sky over about 45 per cent of the frame, then boats, a lorry and a car park — in which the açaí market is one indistinct row of tarpaulins at the right edge. No açaí is visible. Replaced by another frame from the same set.

Viewed 2026-07-30. Correctly captioned but the weaker of the two park frames: most of what fills it is grey paved plaza and the city beyond, with almost none of the water, planting or birds the Mangal is visited for. The companion frame shows those properly.

Viewed 2026-07-30. Wrong subject and branded: the frame is the white neighbouring block on the basilica square, with a large green shop fascia ('Lírio Mimoso — Presentes que Evangelizam') dead centre and about a third of the picture empty paving. Only a sliver of the basilica's masonry appears at the right edge.

Viewed 2026-07-30. Same fault as the first açaí frame: about 55 per cent of the picture is cloud, the rest is a cobbled waterfront with lorries and awnings, and no açaí, no baskets and no trading are visible. Commons has no usable large picture of açaí at Belém — recorded as a gap rather than filled with a stand-in.
Viewed 2026-07-30. Correctly located but useless as an establishing shot: the whole frame is the coffered plaster ceiling of the entrance portico with one lamp. Nothing identifies the building.
Viewed 2026-07-30. A single Corinthian capital filling the frame, with an electrical wire strung across it. Genuine detail of the basilica, but it cannot carry the caption.
